coverage: Every integer seam alignment in both directions, standing/crouched; every valid integer door contact; every open outer-boundary alignment. Uses actual move_exact, bounds, room-exit, door, and enter_room methods. Rendering/saves disabled; room collision data cached.
limits: Local probes are seeded at collision-free edges, not reached from spawn. 1px cardinal steps; no diagonal/subpixel state-machine playthrough, corner-correction callbacks, hazard survival, or moving entities. Top 24px allowance and bottom death margin are intentional. Findings are reproducible local transition failures, not proof every seed is reachable in a run. No guarantee against all untested inputs/states.
